Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::addLoanTerm(termid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = termid),
		currentLoanRequest: LoanRequest = CurrentLoanRequest
	precondition:
		currentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		term.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let loanTerm: LoanTerm in
		loanTerm.oclIsNew() and
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(loanTerm)
}
